title: AC Circuit Analysis & Fundamentals
description: Comprehensive sample study set featuring electrical engineering circuits, SI units, and LaTeX mathematical formulas.

questions.question_text: In a series RLC circuit, what is the resonant angular frequency $\omega_0$?
questions.explanation: Resonance occurs when the inductive and capacitive reactances cancel each other out: $\omega_0 L = \frac{1}{\omega_0 C} \implies \omega_0^2 = \frac{1}{LC} \implies \omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}$.

questions.question_text: What is the SI unit of magnetic flux?
questions.explanation: The Weber (Wb) is the SI unit of magnetic flux. Tesla (T) is magnetic flux density ($1\text{ T} = 1\text{ Wb/m}^2$), and Henry (H) is the unit of inductance.

questions.question_text: What Philippine Republic Act is officially known as the 'Renewable Energy Act of 2008'?
questions.explanation: Republic Act No. 9513 promotes the development, utilization, and commercialization of renewable energy resources in the Philippines.

questions.question_text: What is the magnitude of the impedance of an ideal inductor $L$ at angular frequency $\omega$?
questions.explanation: The inductive reactance is given by $X_L = \omega L$, where $\omega = 2\pi f$.

questions.question_text: What is the power factor of a purely capacitive circuit?
questions.explanation: In a pure capacitor, current leads voltage by $90^\circ$. The power factor is $\cos(90^\circ) = 0$ leading.
